entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can look into that for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the device? Are we looking at a technical fault or is it more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The thing is a piece of garbage and it doesn't work right.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can definitely help with that. The first step for any defect claim is to run through a few quick troubleshooting steps to verify the fault. Do you have the device with you?
No. I don't have time for all that. I'm not interested in fixing it, I just want a refund.

I understand you'd prefer a direct refund, but our process requires us to attempt to resolve the issue first. If we can't get it working, we can then look at a replacement under warranty. It usually only takes a few minutes.
Look, it's not my job to fix your broken product. I just want money back. That's it. It's simple.
I hear your frustration, and I wish I could process that for you directly. Let me check the order details here... I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 13 days ago, on January 3rd.

For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, due to its activation process and for hygiene reasons, we have a strict 10-day return window for a full refund. Since we're now at day 13 and we can't verify a manufacturer's defect without troubleshooting, I'm unable to authorize a return for a refund.
Fine. So I'm just stuck with a broken sensor. Great service.

You're not stuck with a broken device. The product is fully covered by its warranty. We can still connect you with our technical support to troubleshoot, and if they confirm the fault, they will ship you a brand new replacement at no cost.
Whatever. I'll think about it. Thanks for nothing, I guess.
I understand your disappointment. The offer for technical support and a warranty replacement stands if you change your mind. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
